svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: How the marketplace works
svg.desc: How the marketplace works. 12 components in 2 groups. Connections: marketplace.json to plugins/<name>/ (source: ./plugins/<name>); marketplace.json to External plugin repos (source: github); plugins/<name>/ to Claude Code (/plugin install); External plugin repos to Claude Code (/plugin install); Claude Code to Skills; Claude Code to Commands; Claude Code to Agents; Claude Code to hooks/hooks.json; hooks/hooks.json to Hook script (matching tool call); Hook script to Tool call blocked (exit 2 + stderr); Hook script to Warning shown (exit 0 + systemMessage); Hook script to Tool call allowed (exit 0, silent).

text.tspan: Content only. Claude Code reads the manifest, installs each plugin from its source and runs the hooks it registers.
